Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <chbrin5.2...@nyx.uni-konstanz.de>,
Kai Hortmann <chb...@nyx.uni-konstanz.de> wrote:
>It's my turn. One of my vampires is in torpor. I untap him. A ready vampire
>of mine successfully encounters the vampire in torpor and rescues him. The
>rescued vampire is now in the active region. Can he act this round?

Yes. Although, if he has no blood, he must hunt, and that
action must be taken before you do any other minion actions this turn.

Messages.Author: Bob Ellison
Messages.Body:
> It's my turn. One of my vampires is in torpor. I untap him. A ready vampire
> of mine successfully encounters the vampire in torpor and rescues him. The
> rescued vampire is now in the active region. Can he act this round?

Yes. If he has no blood, though, he must hunt - and he must do so
immediately (other vampires cannot take action first). If he has blood,
he's free to take any action he's capable of.

papillo the putrid

Messages.Author: Marko Puumalainen
Messages.Body:
pap...@fc.hp.com (Bob Ellison) writes:

>> rescued vampire is now in the active region. Can he act this round?

>Yes. If he has no blood, though, he must hunt - and he must do so
>immediately (other vampires cannot take action first). If he has blood,

This is not true. A ready vampire must hunt if it begins the minion

phase without any blood. This is in the rules (12.3.1) unless changed
recently.

If you begin your minion phase by rescuing one of your vampires from
torpor, the rescued vampire does not have to hunt even if it has no
blood left. That is because it not the beginning of your minion phase
any more. It must hunt in the beginning of your next minion phase if
it is still without any blood. Of course the vampire can hunt but it
doesn't have to. It could gain blood by other means as well.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ma...@beta.hut.fi (Marko Puumalainen) writes:

>If you begin your minion phase by rescuing one of your vampires from
>torpor, the rescued vampire does not have to hunt even if it has no
>blood left. That is because it not the beginning of your minion phase
>any more. It must hunt in the beginning of your next minion phase if
>it is still without any blood. Of course the vampire can hunt but it
>doesn't have to. It could gain blood by other means as well.

Design Team Rulings are:

any time one or more of your ready Vampires is not tapped and
has zero blood and is not prevented from hunting, your next Minion
Action must be to hunt with one of those Vampires.
